notes.title: Message from Grandpa:
notes.content:
[h3][b]YEEEE HAAW![/b] [/h3][p]In jus' bout' one week, [b][i]Buck Trucker in Rowdy Business[/i][/b] will be trucking on over straight to your personal computers and them there fancy-schmancy Macintosh contraptions, completely free, mind![/p][p]I shore can't wait to see what kinda mischief ya'll young'uns get yourselves into with this here adventure featuring ma' own grandboy Buck. 

And if ya'll ain't seen it yet, your ol' granpappy emptied the last of his savings on a TV commercial spot here on channel 14 news, right here in West "By God". Figure I'd record the darn' thing! 


Anyhow, I gots to get back. Remember to press that thar' [b]Wishlist [/b]button so we know you're comin'.[/p][p][/p][p]So y'all come back now, ya hear? See ya next week for the big hullabaloo release of [b][i]BUCK TRUCKER IN ROWDY BUSINESS![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="OHyjn-p5Szs;full"][/previewyoutube]
